thread:
Lina (Product): flagging a cross-team decision for the 'pike' model onboarding. Customers want a clear deprecation/migration SLA before they pin. Need to decide: default pin TTL, canary ramp, and minimum benchmark gates.
Ravi (Eng Platform): current infra can support metadata TTL routing. We can expose 'pin_ttl' in the catalog and enforce through routing layer. Effort ~2 days to wire into control plane.
Maya (ML): benchmark summary: pike v1 -> v2 diff on multi-turn coh_eval = +0.4% (good) but P95 tail increases by ~18% due to longer decoding per-token.
Dex (Solutions): enterprise asks: 6-month pin TTL or they won't migrate. They want a migration window plus rollback guarantee.
Priya (Customer Ops): we can negotiate 90/180 day options. If we offer 180d, Legal wants an engineering commitment for a rollback path and a documented runbook.
Lina (Product): proposal: default soft-pin TTL = 90 days with opt-up to 180d via enterprise opt-in. Canary policy: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 4 weeks with automated rollback triggers (P95 > 1.25x baseline or quality delta > 1%).
Ravi (Eng Platform): will add rollout automation and auto-rollback hooks. Also suggest a 'compat-shim' label: if 4-bit quant causes regressions, route affected tenants to 8-bit variant automatically. Implementation ~1 sprint for shim.
Maya (ML): quantization sensitivity: 8-bit median drop 0.6%, 4-bit 3.2% on inst-follow slice. I'll produce the regression digest and top-5 failure cases.
Deploy Bot: perf-check complete: pike-v2-dedicated P95=365ms; baseline P95=310ms; artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perf/1731239090
Dex (Solutions): customer incentives: propose 6 weeks credits + migration playbook + a dedicated contact. That usually gets conservative customers to opt in.
Priya (Customer Ops): will draft catalog copy: pin status, TTL options, rollback guarantees, migration steps, and known perf/quality deltas.
Lina (Product): acceptance gates (draft): P50 <= 130ms, P95 <= 340ms OR documented compat-shim + enterprise opt-in; quality delta <= 1% on coh_eval. If not met, require 8-week deprecation runway for non-enterprise tenants.
Ravi (Eng Platform): add to playbook: preflight perf run on dedicated pool, cold-start simulation, SDK compatibility test, and canary rollback automation.
Maya (ML): I'll add an eval slice for prompt-length regression and a small adversarial prompt set for customer review.
Lina (Product): action items: Ravi wire pin_ttl and rollback hooks; Maya generate regression digest; Priya + Dex prepare customer comms and incentive tiers. Sync Fri 9am to finalize catalog wording and roadmap ticket. :thumbsup:
